We are excited to announce our participation in IBEX 2024, where we will be teaming up with NHD Boats and DS18 to showcase the new 355 NHD 2025. IBEX, the International BoatBuilders’ Exhibition & Conference, is North America’s largest technical trade event for marine industry professionals, offering unparalleled access to the latest in marine innovations and technologies.

Taking place at the Tampa Convention Center from October 1–3, 2024, IBEX is powered globally by METSTRADE, the world’s leading platform for professionals in the leisure marine equipment industry. Owned and produced by the National Marine Manufacturers Association (NMMA) and RAI Amsterdam, IBEX is an essential event for marine industry professionals looking to enhance their businesses and discover the latest advancements in boatbuilding.

We’ll be featuring the 355 NHD 2025, which is equipped with cutting-edge audio systems from DS18, a leading manufacturer of professional audio equipment. DS18 is renowned for its innovative designs, engineered in the USA, and its premium speakers are now integrated into the new NHD model. With multiple factories across Korea, Brazil, and China, and select items assembled in the USA, DS18 ensures top-tier quality and performance for every vehicle, including boats.

At IBEX, you’ll have the opportunity to witness the incredible sound quality of the DS18 system installed in the 355 NHD 2025. This system will bring a new level of audio excellence to your boating experience, combining NHD’s advanced marine craftsmanship with the unbeatable performance of DS18 speakers.

As part of the event, you can also explore the latest marine innovations at the IBEX Docks and engage in the exclusive IBEX Seminar Series. Don’t miss the chance to network with industry leaders and stay ahead of the latest trends in the marine world.

We invite you to experience the future of boating firsthand. Come see the 355 NHD 2025 and hear the power of DS18 sound systems in action at IBEX 2024. We look forward to seeing you there!
